# Agent at rows 30-35, Blue at rows 31-34, cols 42-45
# Extend RIGHT to connect to Blue, then retract to collect it

# Extend RIGHT
for i in range(25):
    action(['RIGHT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
# Check if path connects to Blue
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if min_r < 50:
            blue_id = n['id']
            has_path = False
            for a in seg['adjacency_list']:
                if a[0] == blue_id or a[1] == blue_id:
                    other = a[1] if a[0] == blue_id else a[0]
                    oc = seg['nodes'][other]['color']
                    if oc in ['g', 'w']:
                        has_path = True
                        break
            print(f"Blue connected to path: {has_path}")

# Now retract to collect Blue
for i in range(25):
    action(['LEFT'])

# Check final state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\n=== Final state ===")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
        if min_r < 50:
            print(f"{n['color']}: rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c}")

# Check if level completed
print(f"\nlast_action_result: {last_action_result}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
